description: This PHP file is a controller class for the admin login functionality in an OpenCart project. It handles displaying the login page, generating login tokens, and processing login requests, including session management and redirects.

classes.name: Login
classes.description: Controller class for managing admin login; provides index and login methods for rendering login page and processing login attempts.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the login page, manages session tokens, and provides links for login and forgotten password views.

methods.name: login
methods.description: Processes login form submissions, validates login tokens, authenticates users, manages sessions, and redirects upon success or failure.
